sections.heading: What are Consumer Skills?
sections.text: Skills to make informed decisions when buying goods and services.

sections.text: Prevents fraud, saves money, and ensures quality purchases.

sections.heading: Smart Buying Tips
sections.text:
- Compare prices

- Read reviews

sections.text:
- Buying without research
